props.title:
Indian Auto Stocks
Forged, Cast & Machined
props.sub: 23 companies · the metal backbone · what they do · P/E · moat

props.title: Forging & Machining
props.sub: Crankshafts, beams and complex precision parts

props.name: Bharat Forge
biz: The Kalyani group's flagship — a global forging leader
Crankshafts, axles and structural forgings
Also defence, aerospace, oil & gas and industrial

fin.note: One of the world's largest forging companies; defence is a fast-growing new leg.

props.moat: A global forging leader with deep engineering and a fast-growing defence arm — but cyclical, and richly valued.

props.name: Ramkrishna Forgings
biz: India's second-largest forging company
Crankshafts, axle beams and gears, mainly for trucks
Expanding into railways and defence

fin.note: Exports and railways are diversifying it beyond the truck cycle.

props.moat: India's number-two forger, diversifying into railways and exports — but leveraged, and priced at a very rich P/E.

props.name: MM Forgings
biz: A Chennai-based steel-forging maker
Crankshafts, front axle beams and castings
A significant exporter of forged components

fin.note: A mid-size exporter, sensitive to the global truck cycle.

props.moat: A capable mid-size forging exporter — but small and cyclical, with no dominant edge.

props.name: Sansera Engineering
biz: Precision forging and machining of complex parts
Connecting rods, rocker arms, crankshafts, gear-shift forks
Diversifying into aerospace and EV-neutral parts

fin.note: Profit before tax nearly doubled — a strong quarter.

props.moat: An engineering moat in complex precision parts, spreading into aerospace and EV-agnostic products.

props.name: Craftsman Automation
biz: Precision machining of powertrain and engine parts
Aluminium die-cast products
Plus an industrial and storage-solutions arm

fin.note: A key machining supplier to commercial-vehicle and off-highway makers.

props.moat: A leading precision-machining partner for CV and off-highway makers — capital-heavy, and richly valued.

props.name: CIE Automotive India
biz: Formerly Mahindra CIE — a diversified parts maker
Forgings, castings, stampings, gears and magnetics
Owned by Spain's CIE Automotive group

fin.note: Almost debt-free and EV-agnostic — and one of the cheapest here.

props.moat: A diversified, multi-technology parts platform with a global parent — cheap, debt-free and EV-neutral.

props.name: Kalyani Forge
biz: A smaller Kalyani-family forging company
Connecting rods, rocker arms, hubs and gears
Supplies auto OEMs and engineering customers

fin.note: A niche precision forger — small next to the flagship Bharat Forge.

props.moat: A small niche forger in the Kalyani family — capable, but sub-scale against far bigger rivals.

props.title: Castings & Axles
props.sub: Iron, aluminium and the parts that carry the load

props.name: Alicon Castalloy
biz: India's largest integrated aluminium-casting maker
Cylinder heads, manifolds and structural parts
Expanding into EV and defence castings

fin.note: Lightweighting and EV parts are the growth story; margins are thin.

props.moat: India's largest aluminium caster, with lightweighting and EV/defence optionality — but wafer-thin margins.

props.name: Nelcast
biz: One of India's largest iron-castings foundries
Axle housings, brackets, differential cases, hubs
For commercial vehicles, tractors and off-highway

fin.note: High volumes, but low-margin jobbing-foundry economics.

props.moat: A large jobbing foundry with scale — but low-margin, commoditised, and tied to the CV cycle.

props.name: Pritika Auto Industries
biz: Machined castings for tractors and vehicles
Transmission housings, axle and hydraulic parts
A tier-1 casting and machining supplier

fin.note: A small penny-stock supplier to the tractor industry.

props.moat: A small tractor-parts caster — low-margin and sub-scale, with limited pricing power.

props.name: Rolex Rings
biz: A top-five forged bearing-ring maker
Supplies global bearing companies and auto OEMs
A large share of revenue is exports

fin.note: Healthy margins for a forger — bearing rings are a specialised niche.

props.moat: A top-five forged bearing-ring maker with a big export share to global bearing giants — a real niche.

props.name: GNA Axles
biz: Makes rear axle shafts and driveline parts
For commercial vehicles, tractors and off-highway
A significant exporter to global OEMs

fin.note: Strong export franchise keeps margins healthy.

props.moat: A focused axle-shaft exporter to global CV and tractor makers — a durable niche, reasonably priced.

props.name: Automotive Axles
biz: A Kalyani–Meritor joint venture
Drive and non-drive axles, plus brakes
Mainly for truck and bus makers

fin.note: Its fortunes ride the commercial-vehicle cycle closely.

props.moat: A leading CV axle maker via a strong JV — but its earnings rise and fall with the truck cycle.

props.name: Carraro India
biz: Indian arm of Italy's Carraro group
Axles, transmissions and driveline systems
For tractors and construction equipment

fin.note: Off-highway focused; recently listed, sensitive to farm-equipment demand.

props.moat: A driveline specialist for tractors and construction gear, backed by an Italian parent — but off-highway cyclical.

props.name: Kross
biz: Forged and machined parts, plus trailer axles
Suspension products for heavy commercial vehicles
A tier-1 maker of safety-critical driveline parts

fin.note: A recently-listed, fast-growing CV-parts specialist.

props.moat: A newer specialist in safety-critical trailer axles and suspension for heavy trucks — an emerging niche.

props.title: Fasteners, Gears & Belts
props.sub: The small parts that hold it all together

props.name: Sundram Fasteners
biz: TVS-group maker of high-tensile fasteners
Plus powder-metal parts, pumps, gears and hubs
A major exporter, expanding into EV parts

fin.note: High-quality, export-heavy and EV-agnostic — a franchise business.

props.moat: A quality-and-relationships moat — a trusted global fastener supplier, EV-agnostic, with strong margins.

props.name: Sterling Tools
biz: A leading cold-forged fastener maker
Supplies most major auto OEMs
Building EV components through joint ventures

fin.note: The number-two fastener maker, betting on EV parts for growth.

props.moat: A solid number-two in fasteners with OEM relationships and an EV-parts push — but a step below the leader.

props.name: Sintercom India
biz: Makes sintered, powder-metallurgy parts
Net-shape components for engines and transmissions
Lightweight parts for OEMs and tier-1s

fin.note: Tiny earnings and an extreme valuation — priced for perfection.

props.moat: A niche in sintered net-shape parts — but tiny, with barely any profit and an extreme P/E.

props.name: The Hi-Tech Gears
biz: Makes precision gears, shafts and transmission parts
For two-wheelers, off-highway and commercial vehicles
Supplies OEMs in India and abroad

fin.note: A capable gear specialist, but small and modestly profitable.

props.moat: A tier-1 gear specialist with global customers — but small, with thin current profits.

props.name: RACL Geartech
biz: Makes high-precision automotive gears
Exports to premium European OEMs like BMW and KTM
A niche precision-gear specialist

fin.note: Small but premium — its customers are top European names.

props.moat: A precision-and-trust moat — a small Indian firm that supplies gears to demanding premium European brands.

props.name: Bharat Gears
biz: One of India's largest makers of ring gears
Crown wheels and pinions for CVs and tractors
Also runs a heat-treatment business

fin.note: Revenue is fine, but it barely broke even — net profit just ₹0.15 crore.

props.moat: A long-standing gear maker with scale — but wafer-thin profits keep it a value trap risk, despite a cheap P/E.

props.name: LG Balakrishnan (Rolon)
biz: The dominant maker of two-wheeler chains and sprockets
Sold under the Rolon brand
OEM, aftermarket and exports

fin.note: A strong franchise trading at a surprisingly cheap valuation.

props.moat: A dominant, trusted brand in two-wheeler chains (Rolon) — a wide franchise, and cheap at 15× earnings.

props.name: Pix Transmissions
biz: A leading maker of V-belts and timing belts
For automotive, agricultural and industrial use
A big exporter across the world

fin.note: Remarkable margins — over a third of revenue drops to profit.

props.moat: A high-margin, export-heavy belt specialist — a focused niche with pricing power few components makers enjoy.

props.title: The Metal Backbone — in one breath
items: Forging & machining: Bharat Forge, Sansera, Craftsman lead
Export niches shine — GNA, Rolex Rings, RACL, Pix
Sundram Fasteners & LG Balakrishnan: quiet quality franchises
Castings are low-margin; axles ride the truck cycle
Valuations are all over — from 11× to 161× earnings
Cheap isn't always good — Bharat Gears barely earns
EV-agnostic parts makers are the safest bet on the shift
props.closer: The backbone is unglamorous — but quality, niches and exports quietly compound.
